label: DIRTY_ENGINEERING
label_reason: Other ascent lanes were running on this machine. GPU lock held for the whole 6-rep series. Page-cache cold first process discarded from the warm authority set.
gpu_time_definition: MTLCommandBuffer.GPUEndTime - GPUStartTime after wait; 137/137 CBs observed on every rep. CPU wait is reported separately and is not GPU time.

prior_expected.note: Job brief expected ~1.299 s/token, ~0.77 tok/s, host-exclusive ~641 ms, Metal GPU ~401 ms, ~137 CBs. Reality is faster on body and host-exclusive. GPU matches. Reality wins.

authority.set: warm R2-R6, one process per token, GPU-locked, page-warm
authority.discarded: R1 cold page-cache (body 8408 ms) — page-cache confound, not an authority number

correctness.note: Native graph HC SHA is c94da765 on every rep, matching prior native receipts. It does not match the CPU-oracle constant d541c0a25. The e2e test warns on SHA and asserts token_id plus logit ±0.05. This lane did not change operators, kernels, or the oracle constant. Drift is pre-existing, not introduced here.

verification_per_token.note: One token per process. SHA is not the per-token tax. Admission mode skips hash (0 hash_invocations, 3314 admission_trust_hits). The remaining tax is path resolve + stat + remap of 3314 unique chunks. verify_ns is the SUM of parallel worker-thread time, not wall.
verification_per_token.double_stat: resolve_trusted_chunk_path stats the file, then can_trust_without_hash stats it again. Cache check happens AFTER resolve, so a hit still pays path_resolve + open + mmap + metadata.
verification_per_token.correct_shape: cold artifact proof once, sealed session proof, token path trusts the seal. Integrity stays; only the repetition disappears.

second_touch_probe.what: re-read layer-0 attention tensors on the same reader after the token (not in body_ns)
second_touch_probe.finding: Identity is skipped on second touch. path_resolve + mmap are not. Session-local verified_digests does not remove the remap.

allocations_per_token.note: read_verified_range at :1190 is NOT an unbounded alloc — max_output_bytes is mandatory. It still copies when the caller uses the owned API.
allocations_per_token.owned_copy_note: Warm into_owned of already-resident pages is cheap. The 5.39 GiB owned_window_bytes are mostly multi-chunk concatenations inside lm_head tiles, timed in host.lm_head_io not owned_copy_ns.

host_exclusive_classes.overlap_note: host.memcpy and file_source_reads overlap: metal fills live inside expert/shared I/O walls. Do not add the class totals. GPU-idle host ≈ host_exclusive - (metal_gpu - metal_wait) ≈ 410 ms and matches expert_slab_io.

file_source_reads.wall_stage: host.expert_slab_io dominates (406-437 ms). Also lm_head_io 33 ms, shared.w1/w2/w3 35/33/33 ms (GPU-overlapped), moe_control_io 10 ms, attn layer0 7 ms, embed 0.12 ms. attn prefetch is the same wall as expert_slab_io — do not add it.
file_source_reads.disappear_under_resident_packed: YES — streamed expert/attn/shared/lm_head reads exist only because the 148 GiB model is not resident.
file_source_reads.move_to_admission: YES — map once, keep the maps. Do not re-resolve 3314 paths per process.
file_source_reads.move_device_side: YES — resident weights never return to the host.
file_source_reads.can_be_cached: YES — OS page cache (R1 8408 ms vs warm 1024-1067 ms). Process-local chunk cache does not survive one-token-per-process.
file_source_reads.can_overlap_gpu: PARTIAL — shared + moe_control already overlap attn GPU. Expert slab is after the route CB and is GPU-idle host.

mmap_page_fault.note: mmap_ns is parallel-sum of 3314 open+metadata+mmap syscalls, not wall. First-touch faults live inside memcpy/I/O. Cold R1 is the page-fault picture; warm is page-cache.
mmap_page_fault.move_to_admission: YES — mmap the sealed working set once.
mmap_page_fault.move_device_side: N/A — residency deletes the host map.
mmap_page_fault.can_be_cached: YES — OS page cache. mmap syscall still repeats every process.
mmap_page_fault.can_overlap_gpu: YES — happens inside the already-overlapped I/O stages.

memcpy.note: host.memcpy is metal-buffer fills (write_bytes/write_at), ~10.3 GiB. Nested inside expert_slab + shared I/O + counted again as prefetch_fill 95 ms and lm_head_upload 51 ms. Not a second 545 ms on top of I/O.
memcpy.disappear_under_resident_packed: YES — no host staging into scratch slabs.
memcpy.move_to_admission: YES — pack into device buffers once.
memcpy.can_be_cached: PARTIAL — prefetch_fill is the next-layer cache; it still copies.
memcpy.can_overlap_gpu: PARTIAL — prefetch_fill overlaps moe GPU; expert slab memcpy does not.

address_lookup.note: path_resolve (checked_regular_path + file_identity stat) is the dominant identity tax and runs BEFORE the digest cache. 3314 calls, ~400 us each in parallel-sum. tensor_lookup is 140k BTreeMap probes including init/anchors, ~12 ms.
address_lookup.move_to_admission: YES — resolve paths and bind fds/mmaps once into a sealed session table.
address_lookup.can_be_cached: The digest cache skips SHA/identity but not path_resolve. That is the remaining repetition.

table_construction.stage: host.decode of MHC / norm tables from mmap windows
table_construction.disappear_under_resident_packed: NO — MHC still needs host tables unless MHC moves.
table_construction.move_to_admission: NO — they depend on the residual.
table_construction.move_device_side: ONLY with device MHC, which changes the SHA-sealed host algorithm.
table_construction.can_overlap_gpu: SOME — decode of control tensors happens beside I/O.

route_preparation.note: 40 route-id readbacks, ~0.1 ms total. Confirms the DSV4F route-ID serializer hypothesis remains REFUTED.
route_preparation.disappear_under_resident_packed: YES — host IDs exist to choose which 6 expert slabs to stream.
route_preparation.move_device_side: ALREADY device-side; host readback is for streaming residency. dsv-cb-collapse owns CB topology.

buffer_lifecycle.note: Scratch Metal buffers are reused. After layer 0, attn bind-or-fill is ~0.2-2 ms per upload because prefetch_fill already wrote them.
buffer_lifecycle.disappear_under_resident_packed: YES — no per-layer acquire/release of streamed weights.

state_movement.disappear_under_resident_packed: NO — host MHC is the SHA-sealed verified route.
state_movement.move_device_side: POSSIBLE but would change hc_sha. Do not do that in this lane.
state_movement.can_overlap_gpu: NO — between CBs, on the critical path.

synchronization.note: attn/moe/lm_head activation readbacks, ~0.13 ms. Not a wall. Exists because host MHC needs wo_b and moe_out.

validation_identity.disappear_under_resident_packed: The repetition disappears. The seal must remain.
validation_identity.move_to_admission: YES — this is the prescribed shape. Cold proof once, session trusts the seal.
validation_identity.move_device_side: NO — integrity is a host/artifact property.
validation_identity.can_be_cached: Partial today: SHA is cached; path_resolve+stat+mmap are not.
validation_identity.can_overlap_gpu: YES — already inside parallel I/O. Still not free: expert-slab wall includes it.

do_not_polish.streamed_source_io: Expert slab / attn prefetch / shared I/O exist because the model is streamed. dsv-resident-gravity owns deleting them. This lane does not polish that infrastructure.

next_bottleneck.name: host.expert_slab_io (streamed top-6 expert read + metal fill, GPU-idle)

after_resident_deletes_streaming.name: Metal GPU occupancy across 137 command buffers
after_resident_deletes_streaming.note: True GPU timestamps. dsv-cb-collapse owns topology. Host MHC+decode that would survive residency is ~50 ms.
